normativeAuthority: TCVN 10304:2025 · Phụ lục D · D.1–D.6 · Bảng D.1 · trang 110–111

decision.tipN: Arithmetic mean of actual measured SPT points in the prescribed tip window; mean capped at 100.
decision.shaftN: Per geological layer: explicit representative N with provenance, otherwise arithmetic mean of actual measured SPT points in that layer.
decision.shaftBoundary: Half-open [top,bottom); a point exactly at a layer boundary belongs to the deeper layer.
decision.noSyntheticN: No continuous interpolation/extrapolation creates SPT points for Production.
decision.d56Partition: D.5/D.6 are applied piecewise by homogeneous geological layer and summed. This is an HNL deterministic partition of the standard identity, not a newly claimed TCVN formula.
decision.dce: NoiSuySPT and DCE right-end rectangle accumulation remain REFERENCE-only.
